problem: Teams improving AI models on specific use cases lack production-grade evals and training environments, and building annotation pipelines with expert annotators by hand is slow.
business_model: B2B services plus software: generated annotation and eval pipelines with a vetted expert annotator pool; pricing not public

outcome_analysis: MangoDesk is a two-person YC Summer 2025 company that moved from a launch pitch of custom evals and human data to a pitch of long-horizon RL environments. It sits in a crowded and fast-moving category where well-funded rivals and Scale AI entered in 2025. The company claims an oversubscribed seed but discloses no amount or investors, and no outcome events were found, so its trajectory cannot be judged yet.
notes: Seed round is claimed on the company site (oversubscribed, led by top-tier VCs) with no amount or date; recorded with nulls. Simplify lists $130K total funding, one aggregator only, unverified and not recorded as a round. No acquisition, shutdown or layoff reports found. The YC launch described the product as evals and human data, while the YC page now says RL environments; the date of that shift is not sourced.
